Name: Hire Skilled Helpers
Author: CleanpupC
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Hire Skilled Helpers[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i][i]Build a crew. Share the workload.[/i][/i][/center]

Hire customizable helpers who visibly travel to their jobs, work around your farm, and grow alongside you. From watering crops to fishing and dungeon work, your crew gives you more time to enjoy the valley.


[size=4][b]Five professions, one growing crew[/b][/size]

• [b]Farmer[/b] — Water, harvest, and tend your crops.

• [b]Forager[/b] — Gather forage, chop trees and hardwood, and clear debris.

• [b]Miner[/b] — Break rocks, mine ore and gems, search for ladders, or take an independent mining assignment.

• [b]Fisher[/b] — Fish in your chosen area, including supported farm waters, with catches based on the location and fishing conditions.

• [b]Fighter[/b] — Fight monsters or take an exploration assignment for combat rewards.

Independent mining and exploration assignments simulate expeditions from dungeon entrances without requiring you to stand beside the helper. Physical combat and mining use their own active jobs.


[size=4][b]Make every helper your own[/b][/size]

Choose a name, appearance, and profession when hiring. Want a different role later? Change their profession from the worker profile while keeping their skills, perks, health, stamina, and gathered items.

Switching roles cancels the previous job, daily order, and timetable, leaving them ready for a new assignment.


[size=4][b]Manage your crew in one place[/b][/size]

Press [b]B[/b] to open the business menu once hiring is unlocked. The shortcut can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu.

• [b]Roster[/b] — Select helpers and view their profession, daily wage, location, health, and stamina.

• [b]Jobs[/b] — Choose assignments and supported work areas.

• [b]Skills[/b] — Check all five skill levels and progress.

• [b]Perks[/b] — View unlocked bonuses, choose level-10 perks, and check their wage increases.

• [b]Storage[/b] — Choose each helper’s delivery chest using its location and colour preview, or use the shipping bin.

Drag the menu edges or corners to resize it. Your chosen size is remembered for the current session.

Use simple daily orders or build a separate timetable for each helper. Ordinary daily orders repeat each morning. When an ordinary daytime job is finished, the helper wanders around the farm and returns to that order the following day.


[size=4][b][u]Update 1.2.0 !!!! includes[/u][/b][/size]

• [b]Individual worker schedules[/b] — Queue up to 32 jobs between 6am and 10pm, using 30-minute increments and a separate location for each job.

• [b]Flexible planning[/b] — Drag jobs to move them, adjust their start and end times, repeat the plan daily, or run it for one day only. Save commits your changes; Cancel discards them.

• [b]Quick schedule access[/b] — Open the selected helper’s timetable with the Schedule button. Pause or resume it, or use Start now to run a job immediately while pausing the saved plan.

• [b]Cabin bunks and sleeping[/b] — Helpers can rest in available, unclaimed cabins, with safe farmhouse sleeping spots as a fallback. Added lying-down poses, vanilla “Zzz” animations, and six sleeping dialogue lines.

• [b]Perk-based wages[/b] — Daily pay grows with earned perks. Wage increases trigger an on-screen notice, and their costs are shown in the Perks tab.

• [b]Translations[/b] — Menus, dialogue, the mayor’s event, schedules, and wage messages support English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Hungarian, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

• [b]Performance and fixes[/b] — Improved crop searching and worker lookup performance, fixed worker chopping particles appearing around the player, and improved exhausted-worker return handling.


[size=4][b]Stamina that follows the work[/b][/size]

Watering, axe and pickaxe hits, and fishing casts consume stamina using player-equivalent action costs with the helper’s relevant skill level. Sword and scythe actions, harvesting, forage pickups, and loose gems cost no stamina.

Exhausted helpers return to their resting spot, sleep, and recover stamina. They resume their saved work at [b]20% stamina[/b], provided working hours remain.

Helpers at [b]25% health or lower[/b] retreat and rest until the following morning. Health and stamina bars let you check their condition directly in the worker profile.


[size=4][b]Hiring and wages[/b][/size]

Hiring costs [b]500g per helper[/b], including that day’s wages. After that, the base wage is [b]100g per day[/b], including idle days.

Perks increase the daily wage:

• [b]Endurance, level 5[/b] — Adds 400g per day.

• [b]Vitality, level 5[/b] — Adds another 400g per day.

• [b]Fleet-footed, level 7[/b] — Adds 500g per day once.

• [b]Each selected level-10 skill perk[/b] — Adds 1,000g per day.

[b]All distinct perk increases stack.[/b] Additional skills qualifying for the same shared perk do not charge it again. Switching between the two level-10 perks for one skill does not add another wage increase.

Existing earned perks count toward wages. New rates apply to the next payment without charging an already-paid day again.

If you cannot pay, the affected helpers stop working until you settle their wages through the business menu. Their current daily wage is shown beneath their name, and perk costs are visible before selection.


[size=4][b]A welcome from Mayor Lewis[/b][/size]

A standalone Lewis visit becomes available from [b]Spring 8, Year 1[/b], granting permission to hire farmhands. The visit can happen later if you miss that date.

Prefer to get started immediately? The optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration includes a toggle to bypass the permission event and enable the mod’s features.


[size=4][b]A livelier farm[/b][/size]

Helpers have customizable appearances, visible work animations, idle farm wandering, and a varied dialogue pool. Their roster, daily orders, schedules, skills, perks, and work progress are saved with your farm.

All professions begin heading back at [b]10pm[/b] and settle down by midnight. Resting helpers sleep instead of standing around, and sleeping spots are rechecked when cabins, ownership, or furniture change.


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Use Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI 4.0 or newer.

2. Close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.

3. Extract the HireSkilledHelpers folder into your game’s Mods folder.

4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

5. Receive Lewis’s permission, or enable the bypass through Generic Mod Config Menu, then press B to manage your crew.

[b]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Change the business-menu shortcut and toggle the permission-event bypass.

[b]Optional: Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] — Enables additional supported destinations, including Forest West and Shearwater Bridge. SVE is not required for normal use.


[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Multiplayer remains untested in live play and may be unstable. The host controls hiring, payments, assignments, schedules, and perk choices; farmhands can view the crew’s mirrored information.


[size=4][b]Standalone mod[/b][/size]

Hire Skilled Helpers works independently of Stardew Economy. Stardew Economy is not required, but feel free to download it too.

Please report encountered bugs through the Nexus Bugs page. Be as descriptive as possible: include what the helper was doing, its assigned location or schedule, and your full SMAPI log.

If available, enable verbose logging for [b]Hire Skilled Helpers[/b] through SMAPI’s Generic Mod Config Menu settings before reproducing the issue.
